mission.posting: A secure file was sent to a CSEC member, who has no means of decrypting it. They have the needed passwords for the job.

email.subject: Two ships in the night
email.body:
Hey,
A friend sent over some details of a job we're on, but threw it under encryption, and I just don't have a means of getting it open. It's up on the crossroads as "C_EXE_contact.dec", can you decrypt it and upload it to the drop server?
The password should be "quinnoq".
Thanks!
-CSEC Dan

attachments.note:
Download C_EXE_contact.dec
Decrypt it
Upload resulting file to CSEC public drop server.
